description: Returns one monitor's configuration by ID (check interval, notifications, tags, parent group) with its uptime and average ping. Type-specific fields such as url, hostname and port are returned only with includeTypeSpecificFields; fields returns only the fields you name. Read it before updateMonitor. For current status use getMonitorSummary; for check history, listHeartbeats. Find IDs with listMonitors.

fields.description: Only these fields, comma-separated, e.g. "name,url,active"; id is always returned. A type-specific field named here is returned without includeTypeSpecificFields. Default: every field.

includeSecrets.description: Return credentials in full instead of "***"; they then stay in the transcript. Default: false, or UPTIME_KUMA_INCLUDE_SECRETS.

includeTypeSpecificFields.description: Also return type-specific fields such as url, hostname and port (default: false)

monitorID.description: The ID of the monitor to retrieve

name: getMonitor

type.description: A single comparison, or a group of nested conditions

monitor.description: Monitor object with common fields plus uptime/avgPing. May include type-specific fields when includeTypeSpecificFields is true; with fields, only the fields asked for. Credentials (pushToken, basic_auth_pass, bearer_token, headers, ...) read "***" unless includeSecrets is set.

interval.description: Check interval in seconds (min 1, no upper bound)

maxretries.description: Max retries before marking as down

type.description: Monitor type. Use listMonitorTypes for the valid values.

title: Get Monitor
